speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by clarifying the nature of your symptoms: how long has this chronic cough been lasting, and does it produce any sputum or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been going on for over six months and it's usually productive with white phlegm. I haven't noticed any blood coming up, though the cough does seem to get worse at night. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis. The duration of over six months with a productive cough fits the clinical definition; the night-time worsening suggests airway hyperreactivity common in this condition, and the absence of hemoptysis makes malignancy or active TB less likely.
